feature_contract.goal: Remove forced D3D9 EVENT query flushes from each post-Present DirectGPU 1ms readiness window while preserving producer ownership, safe fallback and initial interoperability probe submission.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only R7 game-side DirectGPU EVENT poll flags and deterministic regression/CI; no world projection, HUD, F11, lens, rendering format, SkyGlow, game FFB, host or DX11/DXVK changes.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: At authenticated HEAD R7 WaitForEventQuery always supplies D3DGETDATA_FLUSH; DirectTransportFrameReadyAfterPresent calls that helper for each selected frame, even though Present has already submitted the producer copy and EVENT. With the change, post-Present polls request zero forced flushes rather than one or more per successful stereo frame. Source call-count gain only; headset FPS/p95 remains unmeasured.
trace_stages: Game main/backbuffer and right-eye StretchRect populate the shared eye ring; the producer records a D3D9 EVENT after both copies.
Present returns; 1ms bounded readiness polling uses no additional D3DGETDATA_FLUSH, while initial interop probe remains explicitly flush-capable.
Only successful S_OK publishes frame identity; timed-out frames remain producerPending and the next ring scan checks without FLUSH before a later host/OpenXR DirectGPU consumption.
subcomponents: Separate optional D3D9 EVENT GetData flags in the shared helper, leaving the rare initial shared interop probe using default FLUSH.
Use zero-flag polling only for the high-frequency post-Present 1ms ready gate; leave timeout/failed query frames unpublished and ring-quarantined.
Protect producer ownership and previous successful mono/stereo path with a CI-registered verifier covering nine status/deadline cases and destructive mutations.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: After Present, the DirectGPU completion grace calls GetData without FLUSH and publishes a frame only for S_OK.
Initial probe retains FLUSH while timed-out/failed frame EVENTs remain unpublished and are recovered by the ring owner without forced flush.
The exact material commit runs registered regression, DX9Ex Active full build/package, Domain Isolation, and Full Source Impact when applicable.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R7 WaitForEventQuery invoked D3DGETDATA_FLUSH on every 1ms post-Present EVENT read, although the producer has already sent the GPU command stream through Present.
diagnosis.root_cause: The initial 50ms shared-resource interop probe and 1ms steady DirectGPU readiness test shared one always-FLUSH EVENT helper despite different driver-submission requirements.
source_trace: R7 ResolveDirectTransport issues two eye StretchRect copies and one D3DQUERYTYPE_EVENT after them.
After game Present, R7 DirectTransportFrameReadyAfterPresent polls the producer EVENT and publishes only completed frame slots.
R13/R32 ring reconciliation and OpenXR host use the published slot/frame identity while pending slots remain held across retries.
alternatives_rejected: Removing the EVENT wait altogether would publish GPU-incomplete copies and may corrupt binocular frames.
Keeping forced FLUSH on every post-Present GetData can add driver submission/synchronization pressure, while Present already flushed the ordered operations.
Removing FLUSH from initial interop bootstrap would risk indefinitely unsubmitted first handshake work.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Source helper parameterizes query flag; initial probe retains default D3DGETDATA_FLUSH; post-Present readiness uses 0u with the same timeout and quarantine behavior.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: CI-registered source model enumerates S_OK/S_FALSE/error deadlines and eight destructive changes to polling flag, initial probe, timeout, ring retirement and failure metrics.
